    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- GLOBAL SEARCH

    Window.SearchEntries = {}

    local searchResults = New("ScrollingFrame", {
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,110),
        Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-122),
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ScrollBarThickness = 3,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.Cyan,
        ZIndex = 41,

    })
    New("UIListLayout", {
        Padding = UDim.new(0,6),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        Parent = searchResults,
    })

    local function normalizeSearch(value)
        return string.lower(tostring(value or ""))
            :gsub("^%s+","")
            :gsub("%s+$","")
    end

    local function resolveSearchTarget(target)
        if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
            return target
        end
        if type(target) == "table" then
            if target.Primary ~= nil or target.Fallback ~= nil then
                return resolveSearchTarget(target.Primary)
                    or resolveSearchTarget(target.Fallback)
            end
            return target.Row or target.Frame or target.Button
                or target.Content or target._Row or target._Frame
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Window:FocusSearchTarget(target)
        local object = resolveSearchTarget(target)
        if not object or not object.Parent or not object:IsA("GuiObject") then
            return
        end

        local scroller = object.Parent
        while scroller and scroller ~= main and not scroller:IsA("ScrollingFrame") do
            scroller = scroller.Parent
        end

        if scroller and scroller:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            local y = object.AbsolutePosition.Y - scroller.AbsolutePosition.Y
                + scroller.CanvasPosition.Y - 10
            scroller.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
                scroller.CanvasPosition.X,
                math.max(0,y)
            )
        end

        local old = object:FindFirstChild("SerenitySearchFocus")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local focusStroke = New("UIStroke", {
            Name = "SerenitySearchFocus",
            Color = Theme.Cyan,
            Transparency = .05,
            Thickness = 2,
            ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
            Parent = object,
        })
        task.delay(1.35,function()
            if focusStroke.Parent then
                Tween(focusStroke,.25,{Transparency=1}).Completed:Wait()
                focusStroke:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function clearSearchResults()
        for _,child in ipairs(searchResults:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiButton") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end

    local function scoreSearchEntry(entry, query)
        if query == "" then
            return entry.Kind == "Page" and 30 or entry.Kind == "Feature" and 20 or 10
        end

        local title = normalizeSearch(entry.Title)
        local feature = normalizeSearch(entry.Feature)
        local page = normalizeSearch(entry.Page)
        local description = normalizeSearch(entry.Description)
        local kind = normalizeSearch(entry.Kind)
        local score = 0

        if title == query then score += 140
        elseif string.sub(title,1,#query) == query then score += 105
        elseif string.find(title,query,1,true) then score += 80 end
        if string.find(feature,query,1,true) then score += 48 end
        if string.find(page,query,1,true) then score += 36 end
        if string.find(description,query,1,true) then score += 24 end
        if string.find(kind,query,1,true) then score += 12 end

        for token in string.gmatch(query,"%S+") do
            local haystack = table.concat({title,feature,page,description,kind}," ")
            if not string.find(haystack,token,1,true) then
                return 0
            end
            score += 4
        end

        return score
    end

    local function renderSearch()
        clearSearchResults()
        local query = normalizeSearch(searchBox.Text)
        local matches = {}

        for _,entry in ipairs(Window.SearchEntries) do
            local score = scoreSearchEntry(entry,query)
            if score > 0 then
                matches[#matches+1] = {Entry=entry,Score=score}
            end
        end

        table.sort(matches,function(a,b)
            if a.Score == b.Score then
                return tostring(a.Entry.Title) < tostring(b.Entry.Title)
            end
            return a.Score > b.Score
        end)

        local shown = math.min(#matches,18)
        searchStatus.Text = query == ""
            and ("Browse %d searchable items or start typing."):format(#matches)
            or ("%d result%s"):format(#matches,#matches == 1 and "" or "s")

        if shown == 0 then
            searchStatus.Text = "No matching page, feature, or setting."
            return
        end

        for index = 1,shown do
            local entry = matches[index].Entry
            local result = New("TextButton", {
                LayoutOrder = index,
                AutoButtonColor = false,
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel2,
                BackgroundTransparency = .48,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,50),
                Text = "",
                ZIndex = 42,
                Parent = searchResults,
            })
            Round(result,10)
            local resultStroke = Stroke(result,Theme.StrokeSoft,.76,1)

            New("TextLabel", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,5),
                Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,19),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                Text = tostring(entry.Title or "Untitled"),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                TextSize = 11,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 43,
                Parent = result,
            })

            local trail = {}
            if entry.Page then trail[#trail+1] = entry.Page end
            if entry.Feature and entry.Feature ~= entry.Title then
                trail[#trail+1] = entry.Feature
            end
            trail[#trail+1] = entry.Kind or "Item"

            New("TextLabel", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,25),
                Size = UDim2.new(1,-24,0,16),
                Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
                Text = table.concat(trail,"  ›  "),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                TextSize = 9,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 43,
                Parent = result,
            })

            result.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                Tween(result,.10,{BackgroundTransparency=.26})
                Tween(resultStroke,.10,{Color=Theme.Cyan,Transparency=.42})
            end)
            result.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                Tween(result,.10,{BackgroundTransparency=.48})
                Tween(resultStroke,.10,{Color=Theme.StrokeSoft,Transparency=.76})
            end)
            result.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                Window:CloseSearch()
                if type(entry.Activate) == "function" then
                    entry.Activate()
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    function Window:RegisterSearchEntry(entry)
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.Title then
            table.insert(Window.SearchEntries,entry)
            if searchPanel.Visible then renderSearch() end
        end
    end

    function Window:OpenSearch()
        if Window.Destroyed then return end
        if Window._OpenPicker and type(Window._OpenPicker.Close) == "function" then
            Window._OpenPicker:Close()
        end
        searchBackdrop.Visible = true
        searchPanel.Visible = true
        renderSearch()
        task.defer(function()
            if searchBox.Parent then searchBox:CaptureFocus() end
        end)
    end

    function Window:CloseSearch()
        searchBox:ReleaseFocus()
        searchPanel.Visible = false
        searchBackdrop.Visible = false
    end

    function Window:ToggleSearch()
        if searchPanel.Visible then Window:CloseSearch() else Window:OpenSearch() end
    end

    searchBackdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Window:CloseSearch()
    end)
    searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(renderSearch)
    Track(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,gameProcessed)
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape and searchPanel.Visible then
            Window:CloseSearch()
            return
        end
        if gameProcessed then return end
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.K
            and (UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
                or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)) then
            Window:ToggleSearch()
        end
    end))

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- EXISTING V11 PAGE API
    --------------------------------------------------------------------

    function Window:AddPage(name, iconName)
        pageOrder += 1

        local page = New("CanvasGroup", {
            Name=name,
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),
            GroupTransparency=0,
            Visible=false,
            ZIndex=14,
            Parent=pageHolder
        })

        pages[name] = page

        local tab = New("Frame", {
            LayoutOrder = pageOrder,
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel2,
            BackgroundTransparency = .90,
            Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,44),
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 14,
            Parent = nav,
        })
        Round(tab,12)

        local tabStroke = Stroke(tab,Theme.StrokeSoft,1,1)
        Glass(tab,.56,.84)

        local rail = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3=Theme.Cyan,
            BackgroundTransparency=1,
            Position=UDim2.new(0,4,.5,-11),
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(3,22),
            ZIndex=15,
            Parent=tab
        })
        Round(rail,999)

        local image = Icon(tab,iconName or name,{
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(16,14),
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16),
            ZIndex=16
        })

        local label = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(47,0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-54,1,0),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = name,
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextSoft,
            TextSize = 14,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 16,
            Parent = tab,
        })

        local hit = Overlay(tab,function()
            Window:SwitchPage(name)
        end)

        hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if current ~= name then
                Tween(tab,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=.76})
            end
        end)

        hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if current ~= name then
                Tween(tab,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=.90})
            end
        end)

        navItems[name] = {
            Row=tab,
            Stroke=tabStroke,
            Line=rail,
            Icon=image,
